standard.summary: Lulynx LAB 是一组实验性研究特性的集合，包括几何锁（防止权重偏离预训练流形）、LN 守卫（保护 LayerNorm 不被破坏）、反油炸（防止生成图像出现过度锐化）等。
standard.effect: lulynx_geometric_lock 使用权重投影保持参数在预训练流形附近。lulynx_ln_guard 用正则化保护 LayerNorm 参数。lulynx_anti_fry 限制高频区域的 loss 权重。
standard.whenToUse: 研究用途。探索高级正则化和训练稳定性方法。
standard.avoidWhen: 日常训练不需要。这些特性可能互相干扰且效果不稳定。

standard_en.summary: Lulynx LAB is a collection of experimental research features, including the geometric lock (keeping weights from drifting off the pretrained manifold), the LN guard (protecting LayerNorm from being damaged) and anti-fry (keeping generated images from over-sharpening).
standard_en.effect: lulynx_geometric_lock uses weight projection to keep parameters near the pretrained manifold. lulynx_ln_guard protects the LayerNorm parameters with regularisation. lulynx_anti_fry limits the loss weight in high-frequency regions.
standard_en.whenToUse: For research. Exploring advanced regularisation and training-stability methods.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Everyday training does not need them. These features can interfere with each other and their effect is not stable.

advanced.principle: geometric_lock: 计算权重与预训练权重的偏移向量，投影到预训练权重的切空间中（lulynx_proj_dim 控制投影维度），限制偏移在流形内。ln_guard: 对 LayerNorm 的 γ/β 参数施加 lulynx_ln_lambda 强度的 L2 正则化。anti_fry: 检测生成图像中的高频过冲并降低对应 timestep 的 loss 权重。ghost_replay: 定期用旧权重生成图像作为正则化锚点（lulynx_ghost_weight 控制强度）。hutchinson_probes: Hutchinson 迹估算用于监控权重变化。
advanced.intervention: training_step 后对各组件施加正则化/投影约束。
advanced.expectedImpact: 理论上减少灾难性遗忘和过拟合。实际效果需要实验验证。
advanced.tradeoffs: 各特性有独立的计算开销。不建议同时启用所有特性。

advanced_en.principle: geometric_lock: computes the offset vector between current and pretrained weights, projecting it into the pretrained weights' tangent space (lulynx_proj_dim controls projection dimension) to keep offsets on-manifold. ln_guard: applies L2 regularization of strength lulynx_ln_lambda to LayerNorm γ/β parameters. anti_fry: detects high-frequency overshoot in generated images and lowers the corresponding timesteps' loss weight. ghost_replay: periodically generates images with old weights as regularization anchors (lulynx_ghost_weight controls strength). hutchinson_probes: Hutchinson trace estimation for monitoring weight changes.
advanced_en.intervention: Applies regularization/projection constraints to each component after training_step.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Theoretically reduces catastrophic forgetting and overfitting. Actual effects need experimental validation.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Each feature has its own compute cost. Enabling all of them at once is not recommended.
